property.name: recipe_count
property.comment: the number of build recipes for this branch.

query.name: branch-list
query.comment: Get the list of project branch
query.sql: SELECT branch.name AS name, branch.status AS status, branch.tag AS tag, COUNT(recipe.id) AS recipe_count FROM porion_branch AS branch LEFT JOIN porion_recipe AS recipe ON recipe.branch_id = branch.id WHERE branch.project_id = :project_id GROUP BY branch.id
query.sql-count: SELECT count(project.id) FROM porion_project AS project
